description: Duplicate a script, optionally with a new name and into another project the token can access. Returns the copy's summary.

destinationProjectId.description: Optional destination project id; defaults to the source project.

name.description: Optional name for the copy; a name is generated when omitted.

projectId.description: The project id of the source script.

scriptId.description: The id of the script to duplicate.

name: duplicate_script
title: Duplicate Script
